top_signals.title: Gold Hovers Near $4,000 an Ounce After Steep Loss in Rocky Week
top_signals.summary: Gold fluctuated near $4,000 an ounce after touching a three-month low, capping a volatile week that saw oil surge, stocks plunge and investors seek safety in US bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Billionaires Are Racing to Ride a 3,000% Crypto Boom
top_signals.summary: Some of the most prominent early investors in Bitcoin are squaring off again. This time they are seeking to capitalize on a massive rally in the year’s standout major cryptocurrency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
